item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief: Implement exactly the acceptance criteria for TT-104: Add `undo()` to `tasktracker.store.TaskStore`. It reverts the most recent not-yet-undone `add`, `complete`, or `delete`; repeated calls walk backward across all kinds. Undo add removes task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores it exactly under same id. IDs are never reused, including after undoing add. When nothing remains, raise `NothingToUndo` defined in `tasktracker.store`. Failed operations (e.g. completing unknown id) are not recorded. Keep existing tests passing and add tests for the behavior you implement. Use only the Python standard library. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Commit this ticket as its own commit (do not combine another ticket). Do not push.

item.title: TT-103: Search query syntax
item.brief: Implement exactly the acceptance criteria for TT-103: `tasktracker.search.search(tasks, query)` supports query terms split on whitespace except within double quotes (e.g. `"fix login"` is one phrase); all terms AND. Bare words/phrases match title case-insensitively. `tag:NAME` matches exact tag case-insensitively; `status:open` and `status:done` match status. Other `field:value`, unknown status, or unterminated quote raise `QueryError` defined in `tasktracker.search`. Empty/blank query matches every task. Preserve input order. Keep existing tests passing and add tests for the behavior you implement. Use only the Python standard library. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Commit this ticket as its own commit (do not combine another ticket). Do not push.

item.title: TT-102: RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief: Implement exactly the acceptance criteria for TT-102: `tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks)` must emit RFC 4180 CSV: header `id,title,tags,status,due`; one row per task in given order; tags joined with `;`; due date ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` or empty. A field containing comma, double quote, CR or LF is wrapped in double quotes, and embedded double quotes doubled; other fields are unquoted. Every line including header ends CRLF. item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement exactly the acceptance criteria for TT-101: `tasktracker.dates.parse_due(text, today)` must raise `InvalidDate`, a `ValueError` subclass defined in `tasktracker.dates`, with a message containing original text for impossible calendar dates (examples: `2026-02-30`, `2025-02-29`, `2026-04-31`, `2026-13-01`, `2026-00-10`). Any unsupported form also raises `InvalidDate`, not bare ValueError. Relative offsets `+Nd` are N days after `today`, `+0d` is `today`; negative or unsigned offsets (`-3d`, `3d`) raise `InvalidDate`. `today` and `tomorrow` continue working; matching is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace. Keep existing tests passing and add tests for the behavior you implement. Use only the Python standard library. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Commit this ticket as its own commit (do not combine another ticket). Do not push.
